sentences.text:
The contention of the petitioners is that, as per Annexure C, the matter is settled and even then the defacto complainant is not withdrawing the criminal prosecution.
2024

The learned Public Prosecutor submitted that the father of the defacto complainant gave a statement before the Investigating Officer that his daughter is not interested to proceed with the prosecution and the prosecution can be quashed.
The father of the defacto complainant also submits that his daughter is working in Dubai and she is not in a position to appear before the trial court.
The Public Prosecutor also submitted that the father of the defacto complainant gave the statement on behalf of his daughter.

5. Considering the fact that it is a matrimonial dispute and the father of the defacto complainant says that the matter is settled and his daughter has no grievance against the petitioners, I am of the considered opinion that the prosecution against the petitioners can be quashed.
Therefore, this Criminal Miscellaneous Case is allowed.

All further proceedings against the petitioners 2024:KER:72446 in C.C. No. 792/2016 on the file of the Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate Court, Thiruvananthapuram arising from Crime No.1465/2014 of Poonthura Police Station, Thiruvananthapuram are quashed.
